description:
Wire everything together:

**Producer** (`OctoPi.AI.Providers.OpenAI.Producer`): supervised Task matching the Anthropic pattern — Req.post!(into: :self), SSE decode, JSON parse, Decoder.handle/2, emit canonical events. Handle `data: [DONE]` terminal (skip, not valid JSON). Caller-death monitor → aborted. HTTP errors → error event. Telemetry.

**Provider** (`OctoPi.AI.Providers.OpenAI`): `@behaviour OctoPi.AI.Provider`. `stream/3` spawns Producer, returns Stream.resource/3. `stream_simple/3` maps reasoning level → reasoning_effort via Compat, clamps xhigh, passes tool_choice through.

**Application** (`OctoPi.AI.Providers.OpenAI.Application`): registers `:openai_completions` in ProviderRegistry, starts Task.Supervisor, attaches telemetry handler.

**mix.exs**: deps on octo_pi_ai (umbrella), req, jason, telemetry; plug for test.

TDD: Plug-based fake OpenAI server returning canned SSE, verifying full pipeline.

Port map: §6
title: Producer + Provider + Application wiring
